kernel_of_truth: Both predictions are intellectually honest in form: each names a concrete observable, fixes a numerical threshold, and pins a deadline. PRED-FIELD-2026Q2 (TTB ≥35 nT decay Jan–Jun 2026) is INTERMAGNET-checkable in principle; PRED-073 (SAA western cell drift ≥0.3° in one month) used a CHAOS-7 / IGRF-13 derivable quantity. Today (2026-06-30) is the first prediction’s window-close day — the dome had six months to deliver a posted result and instead arrives at d=0 with status PENDING. The kernel is preserved if and only if the dome publishes a confirmed/refined/refuted verdict inside its own methodology window. Silence after close is the failure mode, not the claim-making. Today the failure mode is one prediction at d=30 silent-terminal continuation and one prediction stepping onto the doorstep of becoming a second silent-ignore case.
why_kernel_does_not_save_it: PRED-FIELD-2026Q2 was already pre-assessed (detail_reasoning, 942 chars) to likely resolve as standard_physics because secular-variation arithmetic alone (≥77 nT/yr × 6 months → ~38.5 nT) clears the ≥35 nT threshold on IGRF-14 forecasts without invoking any dome-specific physics. So even a future confirmed verdict from the dome side reduces to a confirmation of standard secular variation rather than a discriminating dome win — the prediction is non-informative at the threshold chosen. PRED-073 is already verdict=falsified per EXP-612 d=14 terminal-confirmation; today is the 16th continuation heartbeat after the gate crossing and adds no new dome behavior.
